advice: Abstain. In the current SME tile, each of the four loaded FP32 vectors is already used by two FMOPA operations: z0/z1 each pair with z2/z3. Reusing the B vectors for the next row block would require keeping another four output accumulators live; the supplied kernel provides only four ZA.S tiles. No distinct reuse change is known that preserves this tile and avoids added loads or accumulator traffic.
risks: Trying to extend reuse across row blocks without more ZA capacity would require spills, extra loads, or a different accumulation schedule. Their correctness and performance are unverified; the supplied evidence does not justify proposing one.
